blind.description: A stylized ornate wooden standing mirror (cheval mirror). It features an oval mirror framed in carved dark wood with an ornamental shell or fan crest at the top, mounted between two turned wooden posts topped with spherical finials. The frame is supported by a low horizontal crossbeam resting on two pairs of curved, splayed feet. The front face of the mirror displays a stylized painted reflection with diagonal light streaks, while the reverse is finished with flat wood paneling. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and cleanly modeled with no detached, melted, or broken elements.
blind.from_above: An elongated H-shape formed by the splayed feet on either side and the central cross-rail, with two round post finials and an oval frame top featuring a central decorative crest.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 to 3.5 ft tall), and about 2 to 2.5 ft wide across the base.
